geometry: Original 28 vertices / 50 panels / 76 lines; two JSON end caps omitted in the photo/open shell; square perimeters rigid; PLA 0.4 mm on continuous PET 80 um.

frames_and_units.isaac_frame: source joint frame with lower perimeter at z=0 and upper perimeter fixed

actuation.cable_routes: same-corner axial strands followed by the two crossed diagonal directions; see PHOTO_FOLD_PATTERN.md

solver.software: Isaac Sim 6.0.1-rc.7 / Kit 110.1.2 custom Torch nonlinear membrane/discrete-hinge shell
solver.config: sparse solver; physical PET strip bending; midsurface self-contact; frame hinge 0.2 mm; open ends; max_iterations 900
solver.analysis: one accepted force-driven FEM solve per selected family; display easing is not an equilibrium state

validation.observed: Compression 0.372%; signed X/Y bend about +/-0.083 deg; signed twist about +/-0.073 deg at 3 N/active strand.

limitations: Full video-like travel is not reproduced or calibrated.
Cable guide positions, pretension, friction and pre-crease angles are not measured.
Mesh convergence, finite-thickness contact, plasticity, delamination and strength remain open.
